about.title: About Studio
about.headline: Designing Beyond the Visible
about.lead: Iran Zamin Sustainable Building Group (ISB) was founded in 1399 (2020) with the backing of more than two decades of practice in architecture, facade engineering, and interior design.
about.p1: Our primary mission is establishing an integrated bridge between architecture, energy dynamics, and building performance. Empowered by specialized domain knowledge and advanced simulation engines, ISB provides quantitative advisory services to owners, developers, architects, and industry stakeholders.
about.p2: Our methodology is rooted in holistic project assessment from early massing to occupancy, rigorous compliance with the Iranian National Building Code (Part 19), and pragmatic engineering strategies that elevate thermal comfort, visual metrics, indoor air quality, and envelope durability.
about.p3: Every design parameter is evaluated quantitatively across comparative scenarios. Results are synthesized into actionable technical reports, giving design teams reliable, empirical data for architectural decisions.
about.visionText: To pioneer an authoritative building rating, audit, and certification framework aligned with national building codes, green building criteria, and recognized international sustainability standards.

sustainability.title: Sustainability in Action
sustainability.headline: Climate Engineering, Comfort & Efficiency
sustainability.subtitle: Scientific methodologies tailored to arid, semi-arid, and continental microclimates.
sustainability.envelopeDesc: Optimization of opaque and glazed building assemblies, high-performance continuous thermal insulation, low-emissivity glass specification, and 2D finite-element thermal bridge mitigation.
sustainability.daylightDesc: Comprehensive daylight modeling through spatial Daylight Autonomy (sDA) and Annual Sunlight Exposure (ASE) metrics, preventing solar overheating and visual glare while maximizing natural illumination.
sustainability.ventilationDesc: Harnessing prevailing wind vectors and atrium-driven thermal stack buoyancy to ensure passive cooling and superior indoor air renewal during temperate seasons.
sustainability.renewableDesc: Techno-economic sizing and rooftop solar integration of photovoltaic (PV) arrays and solar thermal collectors tailored to regional irradiance curves.
sustainability.waterDesc: Water-efficient sanitary fittings, on-site greywater treatment and reuse, and rainwater harvesting infrastructure for green roof and landscape irrigation.
sustainability.sarvDesc: Sarv-e-Sabz (Green Cedar) is Iran's localized green building assessment framework, evaluating sustainability across 8 core disciplines beyond standard energy metrics.
sustainability.sarvVsPart19: Relationship to Part 19: While National Building Code Part 19 concentrates exclusively on heating and cooling load ceilings, Sarv-e-Sabz offers a comprehensive multidimensional rating encompassing water conservation, indoor environmental health, sustainable materials, waste management, and site stewardship.
